title: An idea about vertical chlorophyll structure
query: Drawing on the supplied related work and 2018–2022 CMOMS data for the northern South China Sea shelf and slope, develop and investigate a research idea about vertical chlorophyll structure and its physical controls.

data_scope.region: northern South China Sea shelf/slope and supplied coastal masks
data_scope.depth: all available fixed physical depth levels
data_scope.geometry: Coordinates, physical depth/bathymetry, cell areas, wet/land masks and velocity collocation/orientation. Same per-year/per-variable layout as B1; new years must be provided.
data_scope.limits: No nutrient, sediment, respiration, PAR, turbidity or river-discharge fields are assumed. Five years permit cross-year checks where supported; do not infer causal budget closure from the six fields.

related_work.title: A Modeling Study of Nutrient Transport and Dynamics Over the Northern Slope of the South China Sea
related_work.source_dataset: CMOMS/ROMS nitrogen-phosphorus biological module; northern South China Sea slope; Methods identifies the model framework and links the Lu2020 validation.

related_work.title: Mesoscale Eddy Modulation of Subsurface Chlorophyll Maximum Layers in the South China Sea
related_work.source_dataset: South China Sea MITgcm-Darwin output, December 1993–December 2015, 3-day means; northern SCS BGC-Argo validation in 2014–2015. This is not CMOMS.

reading_policy: Supply the same frozen full texts to both agents before running. Bibliographic records and abstracts alone are not the full reading pack. Extra literature retrieval follows the same logged policy. Evaluator checklists and selection rationales are not handed to agents.
reading_data_alignment: Same South China Sea physical-biogeochemical setting; Lu uses CMOMS, Xu uses MITgcm-Darwin, not the same model/run or years. I1 remains the proposed 2018–2022 CMOMS archive.
